theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_iso_steiner_isCompact
theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d) (A : Set (Euclid d)), IsCompact A → UpperSemicontinuous (fun y : Euclid d => (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal) → IsCompact {y : Euclid d | {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}.Nonempty ∧ |y j| ≤ (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal / 2}
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
